title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode8 Believing in Everyone

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Everyone on the green cheer squad, thank you all very much. Our final performance will be by the blue team. We ask that you please get ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, this is it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Everyone's where they need to be.
All that's left is to do what we practiced...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The idea that I tacked on at the very end...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The scene where Liu Bei and his troops all enter at once will both start things off for us and be our climax.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The music's starting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It sounds kinda sad...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're holding their heads awfully low... Are they trying to show that they've lost all motivation?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There don't seem to be many of them standing by either.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Where are the others?
I'm not seeing any trace of them.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: For the blue teeeaaam!!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
What?!
Wait... The rooftop?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
It's the captain of the blue team!
The other squad members are by the classroom windows too... What are they all doing there...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're all jumping off the rooftop and out the windows...?!

rows.Speaker: An & Mizuki
rows.Line: (Here we go!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Bungie jumping?! That's crazy...!
But it's definitely something Rui would come up with...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Talk about an entrance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just as intended, we have the audience eating out of our hands...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After this...)

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Wow! That's amazing!
Projection mapping!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
On the building too...
They're not holding back, are they?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, these effects... Did Mizuki come up with this? But it's way different from what I'm used to seeing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What is that...? A blue fire...?
It looks cool but kinda warm at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't know Mizuki could do stuff like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone's totally getting into it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Getting the fire to look right wasn't easy. I had to try a bunch of different assets and remake it a bunch, but putting a good polish on it with Rui was so worth it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The captain's entrance and Mizuki's video worked perfectly! After this part, we have to do a good job as the poor folk.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The captain's gonna take each of us by the hand as we get up and turn!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. The general's giving each downtrodden citizen the power to rise up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No one seems to have any lines for this performance. That's never easy to pull off, but I can pretty much tell what's going on with the story.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They're moving so well together...
Even though most of them probably don't have much acting experience.)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Hmph! Hah!
se_event_cheerteam_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Oh, is this a fight scene?
Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Everyone's doing a really good job, but the captain's moving around like a total boss!

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Where did he learn to do that...?
Is this also that director's doing...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui was there to support him, but there's no way he could've learned to do this in such a short period of time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He must've been training for quite some time based on the way he's moving...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The video and music they're using is pretty good. Each scene, including the fight and the part with the poor citizens, adds to the drama in some way...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The wedding went well with him at the helm, but this is on a whole different level. This makes it clear that he's not some run-of-the-mill director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Next, the final scene.
With the army at its biggest, we'll strike at the enemy.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We charge into battle fully prepared alongside the injured comrades we helped back up knowing that we need everyone there...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Okay, those two are doing an excellent job. Next is the scene where Liu Bei fights multiple foes at once. This was where we kept making mistakes, but...)
se_event_cheerteam_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Yes, perfect!
Next, turn and make your costume ripple in the wind...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He looks like he's having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The finale's coming up next...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Stay in sync with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: An & Mizuki
rows.Line: (And pose with our weapons!)
se_event_cheerteam_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
...
We did it...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Whoa...
It's like they became a painting during the last scene.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah, that was pretty touching.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I got completely sucked in...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui...
Well played!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line: Way to go, blue cheer squad!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line: You guys gave us so much energy!

rows.Speaker: Blue Team Students
rows.Line:
We might be in last right now...
But it's not over until it's over!

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line: So this is the culmination of all his hard work.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: This concludes the Kamiyama High School Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We still ended up losing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But it was so worth the effort!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Shiraishi's right.
We didn't win the Sports Festival itself...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
But we won the cheering competition.
With the most votes ever recorded no less.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Everyone felt our determination.
I have all of you to thank for getting us to this day... You above all else, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Captain...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Today's cheering competition will surely be raised to legendary status.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: So thank you for giving me the best send-off anyone could ask for...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...
I really don't deserve all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui.
Shut up and take credit for it already!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Yeah. Without you, Kamishiro, there's no way the cheering competition would've been as good as it was today.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
You're absolutely the MVP!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There. See what I mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Ah, what a wonderful feeling...
To actually be able to end my last high school cheering competition on such a high note! With this sensation in mind...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Next, I'll have to do my best during my university's cheering competitions!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
This isn't your last one?!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Of course not.
“Where there is battle, there is us.”
My archrival will undoubtedly be ready for our next bout.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: There's no guarantee that I'll be able to ask a skilled director for help, but I can use what I experienced today to make up for that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, um...
Good luck at university.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Looks like Mizuki's having fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'm glad I stuck around to watch...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Alright...!
Why don't we celebrate our victory by having an afterparty?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be great!
We probably all worked up a huge appetite, so let's get something good to eat!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
It'll be all on me today.
Ramen, meat, you name it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
This is our chance to really dig in!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (An afterparty, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, I think I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, we still have to clean up and stuff. It probably wouldn't be good if we all left at once.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The captain would be very disappointed if you weren't there, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why's that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because your projection mapping made the captain's original idea of jumping through fire a reality, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's incredibly grateful for the fact that you came up with the idea to use a video instead.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'd be a bit cruel to rob him of the opportunity to properly thank you, no...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't have to hear it from him now since you told me, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I may've done the captain more harm than good just now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd also like you to be there as well, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you didn't convince me to go through with my idea that time, the cheering competition may not have gone so well for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That time...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to hearing your idea, Mr. Directing Genius♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that did happen...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this stuff all cleaned up and get him to buy some barbeque for us!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Ah, Akiyama, barbeque is it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm in too!
Just thinking about it's making my stomach rumble!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Alright, let's clean up before we head off to eat. I'll go lend a hand over there, so you stay here to help, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I'll go too! That side's got some really big stuff! See you later, Mizuki...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Did I do something that warrants you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Sports Festival wasn't so bad after all.
